<p class="p1"><b>Let’s Make Your Kite Adventure Happen!</b></p>
</div></div><div class="et_pb_text_5 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p class="p1">Have questions about kitesurfing, wing foiling, or planning your trip to El Gouna? We’re here to help! Whether you need assistance with lessons, gear rental, accommodation, or general travel tips, we’ve got you covered.</p>
<p class="p1">📍 <span class="s1"><b>Location:</b></span> Kitepower, El Gouna, Egypt</p>
<p class="p1">📩 <span class="s1"><b>Email:</b></span> info@kitetribe.org</p>
<p class="p1">📞 <span class="s1"><b>Phone:</b></span> <span>+20 12 20172192</span></p>
<p class="p1"><a href="https://wa.me/+201220172192" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><br /><img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/cache/hyperdrop/external-media/bf1279ef0bb83ddda36f9ef8d22900fa.svg" alt="WhatsApp" width="20px" / loading="lazy"> <span class="s1"><b>WhatsApp:</b></span> +20 12 20172192</a></p>
<p class="p1">Feel free to reach out – we can’t wait to welcome you to the water! 🌞🏄‍♂️</p>
